_comment: Pipeline defaults. Override any key with -c your_config.json (deep merge).
_comment_theme: Default = the repo palette: accent Beacon (the highlighted terms only), bar Cobalt (the card edge), background Ink, text Field, muted Slate.
_comment_text: highlights = painted in theme.accent. locked = never split (neither between cues nor between lines). Highlights are locked automatically. fix = transcription corrections, lowercase word -> right form.
